snippet.title: When Ronnie O'Sullivan Trusted A Table That Wasn't There 🎱😂
snippet.description:
Few athletes had ever trusted their sense of a snooker table as completely as Ronnie O'Sullivan, the multiple world champion whose instinctive feel for angles, cushions, and baize had defined an era of the sport. When he donned a virtual reality headset to try a simulated version of the game, that deeply ingrained familiarity turned against him. The digital table looked so convincing, its proportions and surface rendered with such fidelity, that O'Sullivan's body responded as it had in thousands of matches, and he leaned forward expecting solid wood beneath his hands. There was nothing there, and the moment he committed his weight to the phantom rail, the illusion collapsed along with his balance. The episode, widely shared and laughed over, revealed something more significant than a celebrity mishap: immersive technology had become capable of hijacking even the most finely calibrated human reflexes, persuading an expert's muscle memory to act on objects that existed only as light and code.

About the Serial:-
--------------------------

    Odity is a young educated woman grown up in an orphanage. Parent-identity-less Odity, by staying in the orphanage and studying, has now become a well-known doctor of the city. For Odity, the orphanage itself is everything; all her salary, every bit of money, she spends in the orphanage. The caretaker of the orphanage house, Kabita Baideu, sometimes says – “Don’t spend all your salary money only in the name of the orphanage, keep something for yourself too.” But Odity does not listen to her words; according to Odity, the orphanage made her into a selfsufficient woman, gave her a new identity, therefore whatever she does now will only be for the orphanage’s development.
 
      There is a famous businessman of the city named Anabil chaliha. He has many businesses, but his main business is buying land at cheap rates and selling it later at higher prices. He has two sons. The elder son, Nibedan, once lost his eyes because of his father’s mistake. From that day, simple and sincere Nibedan was seen differently by his father, who thought him weak and incapable of handling hardship. On the other hand, the younger son, aditya, is completely opposite. A reckless young man. There is a lot’s of love and affection between the two brothers. Though Nibedan cannot see with his own eyes, he sees the world through the vision of his brother. aditya never lets Nibedan feel his blindness — he takes him everywhere, introduces him to every little things, every environment, so that Nibedan never feels different. 

    One day, Anabil Chilha’s eyes fell on the land of the orphanage house. He tried every way to acquire it, but failed again and again. aditya also visited the orphanage and makes unnecessary noise there, and that is how he met Odity. Slowly, conflict between the two escalated. One day, Aditya was injured in an accident and was admitted to the hospital where Odity worked. The responsibility of treatment fell on Odity. At first, she treated him only out of duty, but gradually some small incidents changed her thoughts about Aditya. Their bond moved from enmity towards love. And later she became the daughter in law of Anabil chaliha. 

    Kalyani was the elder daughter-in-law of Anabil chaliha. Born into a Poor family, being an educated girl, she had married Nivedan under certain circumstances. She found it difficult to accept a blind young man as her husband. Though she always kept a smile on her face, inside she was restless, and she wanted to make Anabil Chilha’s wealth her own together with her brother. After Odity entered the family as Aditya’s beloved, Kalyani realized her dream would not be fulfilled. She began to suffer mental anguish. And One day, after many conspiracies she was able to thrown Odity out of the house. This incident increased the conflict between the two brothers. 

   Odity is now unable to return to the orphanage house because Anabil Chaliha made the land his own at the same time. The people of the ashram now misunderstood Odity because Odity is now Anabil Chaliha's daughter-in-law.  

   After the incident, Odity and Aditya left the house, and their mother tried hard to bring them back because of her love for her youngest son but without success. Meanwhile, Anabil Chaliha became an enemy to Odity. One day, he conspired together with a doctor from the same hospital to defame her and able fired her from her job. The slander was serious enough for her to get a job in a private nursing home also. Aditya mother helped them from time to time, but that was not enough. They both began their struggling lives. Despite being a doctor and the son of a wealthy businessman in the city, they continued their struggling lives by opening a small food stall on the sidewalk.

   After a long legal battle, one day she got her job back. A few days later, Anabil Chaliha suffered from a serious illness and Odity healed him. By then, Anabil chaliha and his wife slowly began to learn about Kalyani’s conspiracies. One day, they learn that kalyani is planning to kill Nibedan, so they throw her out of the house. They welcomed Aditya and Odity after realizing their mistake and eventually returned the land of the ashram. There is also a smile on the faces of the people of the ashram. A happy ending.

 In Today's Lallantop Show will discuss the Congress party's march. Today, Jantar Mantar has been removed from the list of designated protest sites, and three alternative locations have been identified in its place. The Congress sought a meeting with CJI Surya Kant today, but the CJI told them that calling a meeting to discuss a pending case would run contrary to the principle of separation of powers defined in the Constitution. Today, Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, and Neha Bohra led a march up to the Supreme Court. The show will cover all the day's developments. However, the Court made it clear that the investigation itself would not be halted, meaning the investigative process can continue.

 A tanker with an Indian crew near Oman was targeted in a drone attack on Sunday. Out of the 11 Indian sailors on board, nine have been rescued, while two remain missing. Union Minister Sarbananda Sonowal shared details of the incident on Sunday night and confirmed the disappearance of the two citizens.

 While hearing a plea seeking a ban on firecrackers in Delhi-NCR, the Supreme Court stated that there is a need to balance public health and religious sentiments. At present, the Court is not inclined to issue an order for a complete ban on firecrackers, but people should realize the adverse health effects of the same and adopt safer alternatives.

Ministers defend KP emergency as choice between 'daily martyrdoms', tough decision. Info Minister Attaullah Tarar accuses PTI KP govt of having a "nexus" with terrorists. Law Minister Tarar says terror incidents in province rose 196%. Ministers cite worsening security behind emergency decision. Naqvi says PTI negotiations continued until midnight.

KP, Balochistan situations cannot be compared, says CM Bugti 
Islamabad routes to be cleared soon, says Tariq Fazal Chaudhry 
PTI stages protests against governor’s rule 
Talal Chaudry shares pictures as container removed from Islamabad 
Samar Bilour says duration of governor's rule not determined yet 
Gohar vows to challenge KP governor’s rule at every forum 
KP apex committee vows decisive action to eliminate terrorism 

Delhi shuts metro stations, restricts traffic ahead of new protest against election chief. Congress announces march to Supreme Court to submit memorandum to chief justice demanding end to "vote theft". Six metro stations closed in central Delhi. Police impose traffic restrictions, diversions. CJP to seek permission for new protest. 

2 Pakistan Army pilots martyred in trainer aircraft crash incident in Quetta. Mushshak training aircraft of Pakistan Army Aviation crashes near Nawan Killi, says ISPR. ISPR says technical fault caused Mushshak aircraft crash. President Zardari expresses grief over pilots’ martyrdom. PM Shehbaz offers condolences to families of martyred pilots

Dysfunctional CM Afridi among other cabinet members in police custody, confirms minister. Talal Chaudhry says those facing cases will be charged and tried, while others will be released. KP ministers taken into preventive ⁠custody by police, say Talal. If any of them have any cases to be tried ⁠against them, says minister. ⁠Detentions happened on Sunday after governor's rule imposition

Suspect allegedly promised US study visa for Rs9.3m. Family pays Rs5 million to fraudulent agent. Police probe reveals online fraud of women

Pakistani killed, 11 others injured in Riyadh airport attack. Saudi Arabia says it "intercepted and destroyed" Houthi ballistic missile heading for Khamis Mushait. Authorities extend closure of Riyadh airport by 24 hours. Saudi civil authority reports attack on Dammam airport. Iran says ready to help initiate Saudi Arabia-Houthis dialogue.

नॉर्थईस्ट यूनाइटेड FC ने MG इंडियन सुपर लीग 2026-27 की शुरुआत घर पर रोमांचक अंदाज़ में की और मोहन बागान सुपर जायंट को 1-0 से हराया! मोहन बागान सुपर जायंट ने कई मौके बनाए, लेकिन गोलकीपर गुरमीत सिंह और नॉर्थईस्ट की डिफेंस पूरे मैच डटी रही। फिर 92वें मिनट में सब्स्टीट्यूट जितिन एम.एस. ने काउंटर अटैक पर शानदार फ़िनिश के साथ विनिंग गोल दागा।

गोल: NEUFC: जितिन एम.एस. (90+2’)

अगले मुकाबले: स्पोर्टिंग क्लब दिल्ली का सामना 16 अक्टूबर को मोहन बागान सुपर जायंट से होगा, जबकि नॉर्थईस्ट यूनाइटेड FC 18 अक्टूबर को केरला ब्लास्टर्स FC से भिड़ेगी। दोनों मुकाबले शाम 7:30 बजे IST से शुरू होंगे।
